independence.uses: fresh raw OANDA Practice EUR_USD M5 bid/ask only

neuralNetwork.architecture: two independent 20 input -> 12 tanh hidden -> 1 sigmoid expected-return models
neuralNetwork.label: continuous executable R outcome scaled from [-0.75,+1.5] to [0,1], so target hits, stops, and time exits all affect training
neuralNetwork.scoreModeSelection: trained on 2022-2023; maximum predicted expected return; no time-pocket selection

execution.disabledReason: no adequately sampled 2024 confidence tier had win rate >=40%, expectancy >0, and PF >1
execution.signalFrequency: evaluated after every completed M5 candle; WAIT unless a past-only calibrated tier has positive expectancy
execution.thresholdSelection: 2024-only calibration frontier; highest-frequency qualifying tier locked before 2025

gates.development2025: n>=600, 2-3 trades/day, win rate>=40%, expectancy>0, PF>1, better-path accuracy>50.5%
